columns.name: Conf
columns.description: Configuration matrix in the favorable presentation.

columns.name: IsoFlopRows
columns.description: Config-matrix rows yielding iso-flop walls; NULL when non-Kahler-pos.

columns.name: KahlerRefGens
columns.description: Simple reflections in the Kahler representation; NULL when non-Kahler-pos.

columns.name: CoxeterMat
columns.description: Coxeter matrix entries as strings; "P"/"H" denote infinite orders; NULL when non-Kahler-pos.

columns.name: ShapeKey
columns.description: Canonical Coxeter-diagram shape id (e.g. "A2", "B2", "Atilde1-H", "dot"); NULL when there is no non-trivial Coxeter action. Matches the landing-page Explorer's Diagram-shape facet and gallery tile ids.

columns.name: CoxeterKind
columns.description: Classification of the Coxeter group: "finite", "affine", "indefinite", "trivial" (Kähler-fav with no iso-flop walls), or "sentinel" (non-Kähler-favorable, no Coxeter data computed).
